resources.string: HELLO! over a large dot-matrix time and the date, straight on the wallpaper. No alarms, no wakeups.
Time in a pill, the date in a red circle and the day beside it. Ticks inside the home screen: no alarms, no wakeups.
A large dot-matrix time with the day, date and month. No alarms, no wakeups.
A horizontal pill of up to six apps you choose. Redrawn only when you change it.
HAVE A GOOD FRIDAY and the time, on a dark card. Tap for the calendar. No alarms, no wakeups.
A dot for every day of the year and the days left. Tap for the calendar. Redrawn once a day.
The battery level with a face that changes with it. Tap for battery usage. Redrawn only when the level changes.
Your connected earbuds and their battery. Tap for Bluetooth. Redrawn only when Bluetooth tells it something changed.
